objective: In go-chi/chi, the RouteHeaders middleware invokes the next handler twice when it is constructed with no header routes registered (the empty HeaderRouter case): it calls next.ServeHTTP in the empty-check branch and then falls through and calls it again at the end of the handler. Any application that installs RouteHeaders as a pass-through before registering routes double-serves every request. Find the empty-check branch in the RouteHeaders middleware and fix it so the next handler runs exactly once.

explorationSubQuestions.question: In the RouteHeaders (HeaderRouter) middleware handler at this pinned revision, what does the len(hr)==0 branch do, and what statement is missing that causes the next handler to run twice?
explorationSubQuestions.groundTruth: The len(hr)==0 branch calls next.ServeHTTP(w, r) as a pass-through but is missing a `return`, so execution falls through to the end of the handler which calls next.ServeHTTP again — the fix is to add `return` after the pass-through call.
